FullForm and markup read back exactly
most examples make the trip to Wolfram and back exactly
a plain wheel scrolls the page; ⌘/Ctrl zooms; a full-window figure zooms
greedy takes every wheel; none takes none
permutation matrix: n×n grid, one dot per row at image[i]
Ferrers diagram: one box per cell, rows = parts
composition bar: width tracks n, not part count
subset cells: n cells, members filled
subset n defaults to the largest member
Dyck path: staircase polyline, height = peak
treeLayout decodes a preorder child-count word into parent/depth
tidy layout: leaves sequential, internal nodes at the mean of their children
tree glyph: one circle per node, one line per edge, root centred
a lone leaf is one node, no edges; a plane-tree word (non-binary) works too
Young tableau: Ferrers boxes numbered 1..n in reading order
set partition: one pill per block, elements grouped by RGS
lattice path: grid sized to the step counts, one polyline
tree plot draws one circle per node and one line per edge
tree plot layout: leaves at sequential x, parent x = mean of children
a single node draws one circle and no edges

depth cueing shrinks and fades the farthest marker

three faces per positive bar; a zero or non-finite height draws none
